Digital forensic means referring to the scientific extraction, preservation or interpretation of digital evidence for use in legal proceedings.

Log files are files that a system writes to record significant events. An International Mobile Equipment Identity (IMEI) is a unique fifteen digit serial number which allows the investigator to identify the manufacturer and serial number of the model of a mobile phone.
